prior_defects_and_checker_history.resolution: Preserved attempt 1 artifacts (exit_code=2, stderr ReadTimeout); re-executed verify in attempt 2 which completed cleanly in 1525.54s with EXIT_CODE=0 and status PASS (415,693 points).

findings.title: One in-flight attempt (id=4293) correctly preserved as 'started' with unknown usage after network interruption
findings.evidence: At attempt id=4293 (batch 'full-documents-4292', started at 2026-11-08T15:09:49Z), the connection dropped before a response was received. In accordance with M3 contract rules, status remains 'started', elapsed is null, and tokens is null (unknown usage). On subsequent resume, attempt id=4294 re-requested batch 4292 and succeeded (tokens=9216). FullCache.usage() accurately reports unknown_token_attempts=1, unknown_elapsed_attempts=1, status_counts={'started': 1, 'success': 6496}, and known_input_tokens=55,346,360.
findings.impact: Strictly satisfies the audit requirement: unknown usage is preserved and neither forced to 0 nor converted to success.
findings.recommended_action: Retain ledger in place; do not alter or delete attempt id=4293.

findings.title: Windows Modern Standby caused socket ReadTimeout during verify attempt 1; verify attempt 2 succeeded with full PASS
findings.evidence: Verify attempt 1 started at 2026-11-09T09:58:59Z and encountered ReadTimeout after 1138.44s. System event logs confirm Windows entered Modern Standby (Event 506) at 17:09:44 local time, halting the WSL2 VM hosting Qdrant. Verify attempt 2 completed all 6,496 batch comparisons across 415,693 points in 1525.54s with status PASS and 0 errors.
findings.impact: Verification is confirmed PASS. Both attempt 1 failure evidence and attempt 2 success receipt are retained in the review directory.
findings.recommended_action: For prolonged background verification or inference tasks on Windows laptops, ensure Modern Standby / Sleep is suppressed.

findings.title: Ingestion and DB integrity verification PASS is distinct from full hybrid search, COLIEE gold F1, and M4 agent
findings.evidence: m3_full.py implements plan, run, status, verify, and open for document vector ingestion and BM25 index creation across all 415,693 passages. As specified in M3_FULL.md, full hybrid search (combining BM25 and vector search at full corpus scale), COLIEE test evaluation (F1 metric), and M4 agent reasoning are deferred to subsequent deliverables.
findings.impact: M3 ingestion milestone is completely verified, but downstream retrieval and task evaluation must be scheduled in their respective plans.
findings.recommended_action: Accept M3 full ingestion as verified; proceed to full search adapter and evaluation in accordance with the project roadmap.

findings.title: Storage footprint and memory bounds verified across local disk and Docker volumes
findings.evidence: Local cache disk consumption: lexical.sqlite3 is 4.36 GB (sealed), vectors cache is 4.49 GB (6,496 .npz arrays = 4,491,379,152 bytes; 6,496 .json sidecars = 2,514,640 bytes). Qdrant Docker storage on E: consumed approximately 48.6 GB for 415,693 vectors (2560-dim FP32 on-disk) with HNSW graph and payload indexes. Free space on drive E: decreased from 99.46 GB to 42.01 GB (57.45 GB total consumed). Throughout verify, memory usage remained bounded at batch_size=64 without loading the full 4.26 GB vector matrix into RAM.
findings.impact: Confirms bounded streaming memory contract and documented disk space consumption.
findings.recommended_action: Maintain adequate headroom on drive E: for subsequent retrieval index structures.
